baseline_pit_expire.note: pit death on the last life, countdown unanswered, Game Over, title

boundary.note: press_pad_frame = harness frame whose interrupt carries the one-frame button edge; accepted/expired is the original code's decision

harness: tools/g0_rig.py over tools/sms_frame_harness.py (approximate VDP, NTSC frame timing; +/-1 frame)

scenarios.note: TIME OVER with lives left: screen, then the same act restarts
TIME OVER on the last life with no continue: TIME OVER, Game Over, title; a button pulse every 20 frames is ignored
TIME OVER, Continue countdown 9..0 unanswered, Game Over, title; full reference capture
TIME OVER, Continue accepted at digit 7 (+10 updates), act restarts
pit death on the last life, Continue accepted as Tails
button edge on the first update the countdown loop is polling
button edge during the 16-update set-up loop (before the countdown polls): ignored, the countdown still runs and expires
button 1 held from before the death: no new edge, so the screen is not accepted
pit death on the last life, no continue: Game Over directly, title
